dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents in Adamawa, Borno, Gombe, Taraba  and Yobe States, Nigeria as of 29 July 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20250928NGA, GDACS ID: 1103409** This map illustrates the satellite-detected water extent in Adamawa, Borno, Gombe, Taraba and Yobe States, Nigeria, as observed from Sentinel-2 satellite images acquired on 29 July 2025 at 14:28 local time (13:28 UTC). Within the analyzed area of approximately 47,000 km², about 700 km² of land appears to be affected by floodwaters. Based on WorldPop population data and the flood extent, approximately 19,000 people are potentially exposed or living close to the flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
